questions.question: Give two advantages and two disadvantages of a market economy, each with a reason.
questions.expected_answer: Advantages (any two): efficiency, because competition forces firms to keep costs low; innovation, because the profit motive rewards new products; wide consumer choice, because firms compete for customers; economic freedom to own property and start businesses. Disadvantages (any two): great inequality, because owners of capital and scarce skills earn much more; public goods are not provided, because firms cannot charge free riders; merit goods are under-supplied; monopolies can form and raise prices; pollution; business cycles cause unemployment.

questions.question: Explain why planned economies often experience shortages and long queues.
questions.expected_answer: Prices are fixed by the state and cannot rise when a good is scarce, so demand exceeds supply; planners cannot gather enough information about what millions of consumers want, so plans guess wrong; without a profit motive producers have little incentive to increase output; the shortage is rationed by queuing instead of by price.

questions.question: State two characteristics of a mixed economy and explain how South Africa shows each.
questions.expected_answer: Any two, e.g.: both private and public ownership (most businesses private; the state owns Eskom and Transnet); prices mainly set by demand and supply but some regulated (fuel prices and electricity tariffs, the national minimum wage); the state provides public and merit goods and a safety net funded by taxes (no-fee schools, clinics, social grants, progressive income tax).
